name: magic-free-disk-space
description: Finds the storage leftovers on a Mac and permanently deletes the ones you select.

scripts.app:build: bun run app:bridge && cd app && flutter build macos
scripts.app:run: bun run app:bridge && cd app && flutter run -d macos
scripts.app:install: bun run app:build && ditto 'app/build/macos/Build/Products/Release/Magic Free Disk Space.app' '/Applications/Magic Free Disk Space.app' && echo 'Installed. Grant Full Disk Access again in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Full Disk Access: every build changes the signature.'
